newsitem.title: BELGIUM: OLIVETTI SUSPENDED ON BRUSSELS BOURSE.
newsitem.headline: OLIVETTI SUSPENDED ON BRUSSELS BOURSE.

text.p: Shares in Italian information technology group Olivetti were suspended on the Brussels bourse on Monday following their suspension on the Milan stock market pending an announcement, the Brussels bourse said.
"The shares were suspended at 1141 (1041 GMT) after the news from Milan," a spokesman said.
Olivetti said in a statement in Milan it had called a news conference at 1600 GMT for an "an important announcement".

Reason for the news conference was not given but there has been heavy speculation in the stock market in recent weeks that Olivetti is on the verge of selling its loss-making personal computers division.
There were also rumours in recent days that Olivetti was planning a more far-reaching restructuring.
